name: Mare Tranquillitatis (scorecard terrain window)
provider: U.S. Geological Survey Astrogeology Science Center
source_product_id: Fortezzo et al. (2020) Unified Geologic Map of the Moon / GeoUnits_Mercator
map_unit_description: Forms flat, smooth surfaces. Lower albedo and crater density than unit Im1. Numerous ridges. Difficult to distinguish from unit Id.
coordinate_reference_system: Moon_2000 geographic projected to spherical Mercator; R=1,737,400 m; central meridian 0°
source_description: The USGS unified map aggregates 49 lunar geologic units from six regional maps. Mapped interpretation is regional context at 1:5M scale, not a local assay, mineral detection, regolith composition measurement, or engineering property.
source_attribution: USGS Astrogeology Science Center; Fortezzo, Spudis, and Harrel (2020)
usage_note: The public feature service exposes no explicit licence field; preserve USGS and map-author attribution and consult the product page for reuse terms.
scorecard_role: geology_context_only; excluded from terrain ranking and mission screening
